item.title: Scoped Values (JEP 446): Thread-Safe Context Without ThreadLocal
item.description: Preview Feature — Requires --enable-preview at compile and runtime. The ThreadLocal Problem at Scale ThreadLocal has been the standard way to pass context (request ID, user session, database transaction) implicitly through a call stack without threading it through every method signature. It works well with a few hundred platform threads. With virtual threads, it breaks down.
